read.thesis: Siemens Q1 FY26 orders up 10% comparable to €21.4bn, book-to-bill 1.12 and record €120bn backlog; Industrial margin 15.6%, FCF weak at €0.7bn on working capital; EPS pre-PPA guidance raised.

triggers.label: EPS pre-PPA guide raised
triggers.quote: raises its outlook for basic EPS from net income before purchase price allocation accounting (EPS pre PPA) from a range of €10.40 to €11.00 to a range of €10.70 to €11.10

triggers.label: Smart Infrastructure orders +22% record
triggers.quote: orders rose 22 percent on a comparable basis to a record high of €7.2 billion

triggers.label: Book-to-bill 1.12, backlog €120bn
triggers.quote: The book-to-bill ratio was a strong 1.12. The order backlog reached a record high of €120 billion

triggers.label: Industrial FCF €1.0bn vs €1.7bn
triggers.quote: a build-up of working capital, including effects from the timing of payments in Mobility projects

guidance.quote: raises its outlook for basic EPS from net income before purchase price allocation accounting (EPS pre PPA) from a range of €10.40 to €11.00 to a range of €10.70 to €11.10
Siemens confirms the remaining expectations for fiscal 2026.

red_flags.label: FCF down to €0.7bn on working capital build
red_flags.quote: Free cash flow all-in at Group level from continuing and discontinued operations reached €677 million
